description: Closed vocabulary for fixture top-level runner.kind. Unknown kinds MUST fail lint and conformance loading. Each entry identifies the execution contract and ownership boundary; fixture-local runner metadata may further specialize an entry but cannot invent a new kind.

runner_kinds.execution_contract: Dispatch to the canonical namespace in runner.entrypoint; the entrypoint MUST execute the fixture assertions, not merely load the file.
Load runner.inputs and execute the registered assertion IDs against canonical registries and generated views.
Validate each case against its declared JSON Schema, then execute the semantic acceptance or rejection assertion.
Validate each case against its declared JSON Schema and compare the validation decision with expected_valid.
Execute DID method adapter resolution and normalization cases with fail-closed method/profile dispatch.

Recompute every declared cryptographic derivation and encoding from the fixture inputs and compare every intermediate and final byte value; copying fixture expected values without executing the algorithm is non-conformant.

Execute the delegated-bootstrap, root-anchor exclusivity, device re-anchor, generation-fence, conflict-quarantine, recovery-secret-handoff, and recovery-policy signing/HPKE key-role separation state transitions in all declared arrival/crash variants.
Cross-check claimed and discovered profiles against conformance profile requirements and role metadata.
Materialize bounded adversarial inputs from each generator rule and execute the declared limit decision.
Execute RFC 9420 KDFLabel/MLS-Exporter bytes, NFC/HMAC KATs, and RRK eager-seal state transitions from arkret-private-kdf-fixture.json.
